title: Multisubject, multimodal face processing
description: This dataset comprises multi-subject, multi-modal neuroimaging data (structural MRI, fMRI, MEG, and EEG) collected during a face recognition task, in which participants viewed famous, unfamiliar, and scrambled faces. It is a BIDS-formatted subset of the original Wakeman & Henson dataset, designed to support methods development for multimodal integration of M/EEG and MRI data. The dataset has been widely used in neuroimaging methods research and data competitions.
methods_description: Participants underwent MRI, fMRI, MEG, and EEG sessions while performing a face recognition task involving famous, unfamiliar, and scrambled faces presented as initial, immediately repeated, or delayed repeated stimuli. Three anatomical fiducials (nasion and bilateral pre-auricular points) were digitized for MEG-MRI coregistration. Structural MPRAGE T1 images were defaced prior to sharing, and mriqc was used for quality control of the imaging data.
